name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-05-30, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
